notes:
Summary: Hexpond CodeIndex is the internal platform team at a large SaaS/fintech org building a company-wide code search + RAG layer for dev productivity. They currently run a mix of in-house vector DBs + Elastic; pain points: cost unpredictability at scale, slow reranker latency, and messy multi-repo access controls.

Key requirements (from architecture call):
- Index scale: plan for 50M embeddings in initial POC, goal 200-350M within 12 months; repo-level partitions, multi-tenant routing.
- Latency: vector top-k p99 < 120ms; end-to-end reranker pipeline (embed -> retrieve -> rerank -> return) p99 < 250ms for code-search flows.
- Throughput: baseline 100 qps sustained for internal tooling, bursts to 400 qps during CI/dev peaks.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query < $0.02 (business constraint: monthly budget capped).
- Reindexing: nightly full reindex unacceptable; want fast incremental + scheduled nightly snapshots; expect frequent large repo updates (monorepo churn).
- Security: mandatory SSO/SAML (Okta), SCIM provisioning preferred, audit logs forwarded to SIEM, KMS-managed keys, data residency in US only for code.

Quotes: "We can’t accept >200ms for dev-facing code search — engineers will ignore it." — Head of Developer Productivity.

POC scope agreed: run 2-week dedicated capacity POC with a representative 60M-embedding slice (python/js repos). Objectives: 1) validate end-to-end p99 latency, 2) surface reindex cost profile and incremental delta, 3) verify SSO/SAML + audit log delivery.

Notes on architecture constraints: prefer VPC/private deployment for code tokens; may require air-gapped option for regulated code subsets. They want ability to pin model versions and have deterministic fallback to smaller/quantized model during peak to control costs.

Decision criteria: latency SLOs met, predictable monthly cost estimate under target, security sign-off.

Stubs/links: security FAQ in Drive, Fireflies call transcripts attached, Jira tickets created for infra questions (RWI-1123 / RWI-1189).
